_doc: Broadcast-style camera behind the offense (render/view.ts), in yards. The axis always points straight downfield: it never rotates with the QB or his gaze; scrambles only move it along the field. follow* are smoothing rates per second. fov: vertical field of view of the broadcast view (narrower than QB eyes). defense: behind the user's cornerback (back = yards behind him), looking lookAhead yards past him toward the offense, leaning lookToBall of the way toward the ball; he stays centered.
